Exploring web synthesizers, digital signal processing (DSP), Ableton custom extensions, and podcast hosting for "Creative Engineering".

  • Firebase: Implementing unified authentication, remote configurations, and Firestore security systems.

Deep engineering contribution history across key developer platforms:

  • Firebase Studio & CLI Tools: Built initial user-focused UI frameworks.
  • Project IDX: Assisted early validation and SDK embedding.
  • Developer Solutions: Advocated and mapped client developer requirements.
  • Lit Framework & Material Design: Standardized custom theme variables and templates.

I write and package free software. Most of my time goes into mainline Linux and Nura (formerly postmarketOS) support for Qualcomm phones, Linux distribution tooling, and small, fast system services in Rust and Go. When something upstream breaks, I send the fix back. Over the years that has meant patches to the Linux kernel, Nura, systemd, LocalAI, ScummVM, DevilutionX and EasyEffects.

What I work on

Area Highlights
Kernel Linux mainline: Qualcomm MSM8953/SDM630 device trees, PMI8950 PWM support in leds-qcom-lpg, a Novatek touchscreen fix · Nura: linux-postmarketos-qcom-msm8953 kernel upgrades, ALSA UCM audio profiles, lk2nd-msm8953, and the ports for the Xiaomi Redmi 5 Plus (vince) and Redmi Note 6 Pro (tulip)
Packaging yap: builds deb, rpm and apk packages from PKGBUILD specs · PKGBUILD: the Arch Linux recipes I maintain · android-udev-rules: one of the most comprehensive sets of Android udev rules around
Rust rmpd: an MPD server in pure Rust · netsukuku-rs: a new implementation of the Netsukuku mesh network · opensubsonic-rs · aulos: a music player for the COSMIC desktop
Identity opencie: an app for signing and verifying documents with the Italian electronic ID card (CIE) · opencie-pkcs11: a cross-platform PKCS#11 library for the CIE
Embedded simonpi: runs Raspberry Pi images in QEMU · qemu-kernels-rpi: the matching QEMU kernel builds
Media lactea: a MilkDrop 2/3 and projectM-compatible music visualizer in pure Rust on wgpu · easyeffects-presets · rivulet-engine · shisper: subtitles generated with whisper.cpp
